arguments.cmd:
python - <<'PY'
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

labels = [
    "Low income\n1990","Low income\n2024",
    "Lower-middle\n1990","Lower-middle\n2024",
    "Upper-middle\n1990","Upper-middle\n2024",
    "High income\n1990","High income\n2024"
]
communicable = np.array([71.2,52.8,52.4,27.1,28.7,11.3,8.3,4.1])
ncd = np.array([19.8,37.4,36.1,60.5,57.3,77.2,81.6,87.8])
injury = np.array([9.0,9.8,11.5,12.4,14.0,11.5,10.1,8.1])

x = np.arange(len(labels))

plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(16,9), dpi=150)

colors = {
    'Communicable': '#2B6CB0',
    'NCD': '#C53030',
    'Injury': '#6B7280'
}

ax.bar(x, communicable, color=colors['Communicable'], label='Communicable (%)', width=0.72)
ax.bar(x, ncd, bottom=communicable, color=colors['NCD'], label='NCD (%)', width=0.72)
ax.bar(x, injury, bottom=communicable+ncd, color=colors['Injury'], label='Injury (%)', width=0.72)

ax.set_title('Global DALY Burden Composition by Income Group and Year (1990 vs 2024)', fontsize=20, pad=18, weight='bold')
ax.set_ylabel('Share of total DALYs (%)', fontsize=14)
ax.set_xlabel('World Bank income group and year', fontsize=14, labelpad=10)
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(labels, fontsize=11)
ax.set_ylim(0,100)
ax.set_yticks(np.arange(0,101,10))

ax.legend(title='Disease Category', loc='upper center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.09), ncol=3, frameon=False, fontsize=12, title_fontsize=12)

for i in range(len(x)):
    ax.text(x[i], communicable[i]/2, f"{communicable[i]:.1f}%", ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9, color='white', weight='bold')
    ax.text(x[i], communicable[i] + ncd[i]/2, f"{ncd[i]:.1f}%", ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9, color='white', weight='bold')
    ax.text(x[i], communicable[i] + ncd[i] + injury[i]/2, f"{injury[i]:.1f}%", ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8, color='white', weight='bold')

for idx in [0,2,4,6]:
    ax.axvline(idx+1.5, color='#d1d5db', lw=1, ls='--', alpha=0.7)

ax.text(0.01, -0.17, 'Source: source_data.json (daly_by_income_group). DALY = disability-adjusted life years.',
        transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=10, color='#4b5563')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
PY
